[[File:Cherry.png|thumb|250px|Cherry]] '''Cherry''' (Japanese: '''チェリー''' ''Cherry'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP156|The Psychic Sidekicks]]''. Cherry lives in [[Len Town]], but she plans to leave her home and become a {{t|Psychic}} [[Pokémon Master]]. After meeting in the forest, she challenged {{Ash}} to a {{pkmn|battle}}. However, {{AP|Pikachu}} caused her {{p|Girafarig}} to become {{status|Paralysis|paralyzed}}, and it fainted as a result. Cherry admired the bond Ash shared with Pikachu, and expressed that she wished she could be that close with her Girafarig. It was rumored that when Psychic-type Pokémon share a close bond with their trainer, they can communicate telepathically. Cherry then invited Ash and {{ashfr}} to visit her hometown of Len Town. Not long afterwards, {{TRT}} appeared, using a giant {{p|Gengar}} [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]] to swallow all of the {{t|Psychic}} Pokémon in Len Town. Using her bond with Girafarig, Cherry was able to foresee what moves Team Rocket was going to use. This allowed Ash to free the stolen Pokémon. Girafarig's {{m|Future Sight}} then sent Team Rocket blasting off again. Ash and his friends congratulated Cherry on her victory. Cherry vowed that she and Girafarig would not give up on becoming the greatest Psychic Pokémon and Trainer team. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Cherry |pkmn=Girafarig |type1=Normal |type2=Psychic |img=Cherry Girafarig.png |epnum=EP156 |epname=The Psychic Sidekicks! |vajp=Rikako Aikawa |vaen=Rikako Aikawa |desc=Cherry's {{p|Girafarig}} is Cherry's only known Pokémon. It is a tradition in [[Len Town]] for the residents to have a {{type|Psychic}} Pokémon, because of the {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon in the [[Ilex Forest|nearby woods]]. Girafarig's tail was first spotted by [[Misty's Psyduck]], but it revealed its full self when Cherry introduced herself to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Afterwards, it was used in a {{pkmn|battle}} with {{AP|Pikachu}}. With the help of [[move]]s like Future Sight, it nearly defeated Pikachu, but it fainted from Pikachu's {{m|Thunder}}. Later when {{TRT}} was stealing Psychic-type Pokémon with their giant {{p|Gengar}} [[Team Rocket's mechas|mecha]], Girafarig tried to stop the mecha with Psybeam, but the attack was deflected. Girafarig's [[friendship]] with Cherry allowed it to communicate telepathically with her to show its {{pkmn|Trainer}} the future. With great teamwork, Pikachu was able to dodge Gengar's tongue and Girafarig lifted Pikachu up with Confusion. Pikachu managed to free the stolen Pokémon, and Girafarig's Future Sight blasted Team Rocket off. With this new victory Cherry vowed to make Girafarig stronger. Girafarig's known moves are {{m|Future Sight}}, {{m|Stomp}}, {{m|Psybeam}}, and {{m|Confusion}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja=かないみか ''[[Mika Kanai]]'' |en=[[Kerry Williams]] |ar=جیهان ملا ''Jihan Malla'' |fr_eu=Lydia Cherton |he=דון לני-גבאי ''Dawn Lanny-Gabay'' |it=Deborah Morese (Mediaset dub)
